Princely kin traveling to or remaining at court linked household and politics. Lodging, attendants and messages home needed arrangements. Relatives could provide guarantees or help communication and audiences; families shared the risks of distance. Escorts needed destinations, hosts and document handovers. Waiting for an audience consumed food and fodder, and changed routes could separate letters, replies and promises.
